entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A prodigy who earned early admission to Strixhaven, chooses Quandrix, and receives mysterious packages of ribbons from her grandmother Nimiroti.

entities.name: Nimiroti Wola
entities.description: Zimone's grandmother, a former Strixhaven professor who solved the Vorzani Conjecture, wiped her own memory to protect it from the Oriq, and now lives in a sanctuary.

entities.name: Amaka
entities.description: Zimone's friend who chose Prismari.

entities.name: Nnanyielugo
entities.description: Zimone's friend who chose Silverquill.

entities.name: Wallader the Eventual
entities.description: A diminutive turtlefolk courier who delivers Zimone's mystery packages.

entities.name: Kianne
entities.description: A Quandrix dean who teaches forms and fractals and warns Zimone away from the Vorzani Conjecture.

entities.name: Imbraham
entities.description: A winged Quandrix dean who teaches theory and who once taught Nimiroti.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: The Oriq leader who has followed Zimone for years and offers to share the Vorzani Conjecture with her.

entities.name: Pita
entities.description: An Oriq agent with Extus who argues that destroying Strixhaven would spread magic.

entities.name: Codex Vocifera
entities.description: A talking tome on four metal legs that tells Zimone what happened to her grandmother.

entities.name: Isabough
entities.description: The treefolk librarian of the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Ellina
entities.description: The barista of Firejolt Café.

entities.name: Zihir
entities.description: Zimone's father.

entities.name: Dipo
entities.description: Zimone's parent, who objects to her going to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A masked society that captured Nimiroti and now recruits Zimone.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: The mathematics college Zimone joins.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university of mages.

entities.name: Firejolt Café
entities.description: A café where students gather.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: The library where Zimone requests the Vorzani book.

entities.name: Torches of Enlightenment
entities.description: Stone torches where the Codex meets Zimone at night.

entities.name: The Sanctuary of the Lost
entities.description: A safe haven for those affected by magic where Nimiroti lives.

entities.name: Vorzani Conjecture
entities.description: An ancient unsolved magical and mathematical ritual about infinite sequences of unpredictable mana, said to hold the essence of the universe.

entities.name: Mage Tower
entities.description: The end-of-session magical sport game.

events.summary: Zimone waits in Firejolt Café counting bubbles on the last day of exams.
events.quote: Zimone Wola counts the clusters of bubbles floating in her glass of Kiwano Fizzy Pop.

events.summary: Zimone recalls Dean Kianne urging her to consider Quandrix.
events.quote: Please tell me you are considering Quandrix College for next year.

events.summary: The three friends have each chosen different colleges.
events.quote: Zimone chose Quandrix, Amaka Prismari, and Nnanyielugo Silverquill.

events.summary: Wallader tells Zimone a mystery package arrived for her two weeks ago.
events.quote: A package came in for you two weeks ago.

events.summary: Zimone realizes she knows who sent the package, one she has received for seven years.
events.quote: she has received the same package, just like the one Wallader described, for seven years now

events.summary: On her seventh birthday, Zimone received her first box of eight blue-green ribbons from her grandmother (flashback).
events.quote: Inside the velveteen-lined box were eight green-and-blue-striped ribbons and a note

events.summary: Zimone learns pieces of the story that her grandmother left Strixhaven after forgetting things and was never seen again (flashback).
events.quote: that she left Strixhaven and was never seen again

events.summary: Silverquill wins the Mage Tower game after hypnotizing Quandrix's captain.
events.quote: Silverquill College won even though one of their players hypnotized Quandrix College's captain at the finals.

events.summary: Zimone counts 377 ribbons and reads that this will be the last package.
events.quote: So, this will be the last one.

events.summary: Dean Imbraham teaches theory to second-year Quandrix mages.
events.quote: The most important thing you have to know about theory is that it is just substance we haven't figured out yet

events.summary: Imbraham tells Zimone she looks like her grandmother, whom he once taught.
events.quote: Your grandmother, Nimiroti Wola. Taught her in this same class many years ago.

events.summary: Imbraham praises Nimiroti as the best student he ever taught.
events.quote: The best student I've ever taught.

events.summary: Kianne tells Zimone her name is who she is.
events.quote: At this point, Zimone Wola is more than your name.

events.summary: Zimone takes out the Vorzani Conjecture book from the Biblioplex, last signed out by Nimiroti.
events.quote: Zimone had peeped into the record scroll as Isabough's branches reached to the farthest shelves to find the book.

events.summary: Zimone finds a note in her grandmother's handwriting hidden in the book.
events.quote: Packages of Ribbons. Numbers one step backward to go on forever. Living books that talk to you on the pathway of light.

events.summary: Zimone dreams of the Arithmodrome crumbling as she tries to save a woman braiding ribbons.
events.quote: Zimone races toward her to save her, because the Arithmodrome is crumbling.

events.summary: Kianne suspects Zimone and Imbraham of pursuing the Vorzani Conjecture and Zimone resists.
events.quote: Fear that I will find out what you and Dean Imbraham have been up to.

events.summary: Kianne says Imbraham egged Nimiroti on until the Oriq got hold of her.
events.quote: egged her on until the Oriq got hold of her

events.summary: The Codex Vocifera tells Zimone that Nimiroti solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq.
events.quote: Nimiroti figured out the Vorzani Conjecture.

events.summary: Zimone's ribbon braid weaves itself into patterns as she senses danger.
events.quote: The braid, as if it has a mind of its own, weaves into countless patterns.

events.summary: Zimone hits her head on a torch and loses consciousness.
events.quote: She spins to investigate but trips and slams her head against one of the torches.

events.summary: Zimone wakes to find Extus and Pita, who introduce themselves.
events.quote: My name is Extus

events.summary: Extus says they have followed Zimone for years and know about the packages.
events.quote: We have followed you for years.

events.summary: Extus offers to share what the Oriq knows about the Conjecture to control the universe.
events.quote: And we'll tell you what we know, and together, we can control the universe.

events.summary: Zimone refuses and lashes Extus and Pita into a wall with the ribbon braid.
events.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

events.summary: Pita argues Strixhaven hoards magic and that destroying it would spread magic to all.
events.quote: If we destroy it, then anyone anywhere in the world can practice magic.

events.summary: Dean Kianne bursts in with Amaka and Nnanyielugo.
events.quote: Get away from her!

events.summary: Kianne redirects Extus's fireball, and Zimone stops and douses it with her braid.
events.quote: Zimone swirls the braid of blue-green ribbons, weaving it into the tiny cracks of time and space

events.summary: Extus departs, saying they will meet again.
events.quote: Though I trust we'll meet again, Zimone Wola.

events.summary: Rumors spread that Zimone is an Oriq recruit and her friends avoid her.
events.quote: somehow, the rumor of her being an Oriq recruit spread around Strixhaven

events.summary: Zimone visits Nimiroti at the Sanctuary of the Lost and finds her braiding ribbons into her hair.
events.quote: Nimiroti is sitting beside the window with her back turned, braiding stripes of blue-green ribbons into her graying locks.

events.summary: Nimiroti, who no longer remembers her, tells Zimone she is someone she loves.
events.quote: I don't know who you are, but I know you're someone I love.

relations.quote: the three friends are laughing and talking loudly between sips

relations.note: The Oriq captured her over the Conjecture.
relations.quote: When the Oriq learned about it from their spies in Strixhaven, they captured her.
